sources.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Soul of Meal production character animation source. Input image is REFERENCE of the current same creature identity; preserve species, silhouette, equipment and colors. Redraw in polished anime chibi cel shading, crisp game sprite linework, matching existing Soul of Meal. Exactly SIXTEEN complete character sprites in FOUR columns by FOUR rows, equal invisible cells. Row1 IDLE: four distinct breathing/looking poses. Row2 WALK/LOCOMOTION: four alternating steps, wing beats or floating motion. Row3 ATTACK: ready, windup, decisive contact, recovery. Row4 CAST: prepare, gather gesture, release, settle. Face three-quarter RIGHT in EVERY cell, uniform physical scale, same feet/base baseline. Zoom out: each COMPLETE actor inside CENTRAL 60 percent of its cell, leaving 20 percent transparent gutters at all edges; NO crossing cell boundaries. Full body, wings, antennae, weapon tips and tails inside cell. Transparent RGBA. No scenery, ground, shadows, text, numbers, labels, outlines, watermark or painted magic/particles. Ignore any small clipped neighbor fragments in the old reference; only redraw the central complete creature. Main identity: small friendly sentient TEA MOTH, ivory fluffy round face with big green eyes, two long GOLD spiral antennae, FOUR translucent JADE GREEN LEAF-shaped wings with pale yellow leaf-vein tracery, layered green tea-leaf tunic, tiny ivory limbs. No human face, hands or weapons. Flutter, hop and lean antennae for attack; cast raises tiny forelimbs. Keep all four leaf wings and both spiral antennae.
